ideas.pitch: An autonomous agentic workflow that extracts non-standard enterprise procurement rules from unstructured contracts and instantly configures accurate quotes.
ideas.problem_statement: Enterprise SaaS: Automating complex configure-price-quote workflows without manual sales engineering overhead.
ideas.title: AgenticCPQ - Automated Complex Quote Generation System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets enterprise workflow automation directly, showcasing complex multi-step agent execution that appeals heavily to judges looking for enterprise productivity gains.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered recruitment agent that validates applicant GitHub commits and past project architectures to generate objective skill competency scores.
ideas.problem_statement: HR Tech & Recruitment: Eliminating bias and inefficiencies in initial technical candidate screening.
ideas.title: ResumeSifter AI - Automated Technical Hiring & Skill Verification Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a universal HR pain point with concrete code-level analysis rather than simple keyword matching, satisfying enterprise requirements for hiring accuracy.

ideas.pitch: A real-time DevOps dashboard that ingests cloud server logs, clusters error signatures, and triggers autonomous remediation scripts.
ideas.problem_statement: Cloud & DevOps: Reducing mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR) for complex distributed cloud infrastructure failures.
ideas.title: LogSentry - AI-Driven Cloud Infrastructure Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven log-analysis architectures with real-time dashboards that judges can test instantly during the live demo.

ideas.pitch: A zero-trust audit tool that verifies software bill of materials (SBOM) authenticity and flags unauthorized dependency tampering using cryptographic ledgers.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity & Digital Trust: Securing modern software supply chains against malicious dependency injection.
